name: Lyon Farms Wm Lyon's blueberry and pumpkin farm
tagline: Lyon Farms, 1544 Munns Road, Creedmoor, NC (2026)
description: Lyon Farms Wm Lyon's blueberry and pumpkin farm is an independent pumpkin patch in Creedmoor, NC. It grows Blueberries, with picking through summer. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
